params.title: Params
params.description: Type-specific job parameters, validated against the type's params model.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project to scope this job to (for filtering/visibility). Falls back to the params' project_id when omitted.

schema.title: CreateJobRequest
schema.description: Request body for creating a job. Params are validated per job type.

type.description: The registered job type to run.
type.title: Type

wait.description: When true, block until the job reaches a terminal state and return the full JobRecord instead of CreateJobResponse.
wait.title: Wait

timeout.description: Seconds to wait when wait=true (504 on timeout). Omit to wait indefinitely.
timeout.title: Timeout
